Question: At the end of a professional bowling tournament, the top \(5\) bowlers have a play-off. First #\(5\) bowls #\(4.\) The loser receives \(5\)th prize and the winner bowls #\(3\) in another game. The loser of this game receives \(4\)th prize and the winner bowls #\(2.\) The loser of this game receives \(3\)rd prize and the winner bowls #\(1.\) The winner of this game gets \(1\)st prize and the loser gets \(2\)nd prize. In how many orders can bowlers #\(1\) through #\(5\) receive the prizes?
